programs. The two SFT datasets contain approximately equal numbers of
training examples. Single-response labels are independently filtered responses;
composed labels pool discoveries across responses.
\revision{Both datasets start from the same program pool, and over 93\% of the distinct
prompts in the composed-label dataset also appear in the single-response dataset.

examples with none remaining, without applying a coverage threshold.\par}

old:
Loopy follows a similar high-level strategy to AutoSpec: generating multiple
candidate invariants and using Houdini to filter them.
Loopy's initial responses contain invariant annotations in 98.8\% of cases,
but its native extractor passes only 1.75\% of initial responses to Houdini.
Generating annotations therefore does not ensure that they reach the

new:
Loopy follows a similar high-level strategy to AutoSpec: generating multiple
candidate invariants and using Houdini to filter them.
Loopy's initial responses contain invariant annotations in 98.8\% of cases,
but its native extractor passes only 1.75\% of initial responses to Houdini.
\revision{Its extractor requires paired Markdown fences and drops unfenced
ACSL annotations. After correcting extraction and re-verifying the saved
initial and repair responses, Loopy reaches 68.03\% verification.}
